title: Complaint about a late furniture delivery
prompts:
You ordered a sofa from a furniture shop and paid for delivery on a particular day. The sofa arrived a week late and was damaged.

Write a letter to the appropriate person or organisation. In your letter

Write at least 150 words. You do NOT need to write any addresses.
